print.name: Clever Tonie
print.summary: This Clever Tonie is a custom Tonie for the Toniebox. You can use it to play custom content on your Toniebox.
print.description:
This Clever Tonie is a custom Tonie for the Toniebox. You can use it to play educational content or other audio content on your Toniebox. It only works with the teddyCloud or teddyBench. This also requires a compatible RFID tag that is accepted by the Toniebox (ICODE SLIX-L RF interface, ISO/IEC 15693, 13.56 MHz).

You can find them for example here: https://shop.electricky.de/T-Box-Modding/SLIX-L-Toniebox-kompatible-RFID-Tags-durchsichtiger-Sticker-original-NXP.html

 

The RFID tag needs a minimum distance of about 5mm from the Toniebox to be detected. The tag cannot be placed completely vertically, otherwise the Toniebox will not read it. It must be inclined at least 10-15 degrees. The maximum diameter for the tag is 38 mm.

You also need two 10x3 mm magnets. They are not required but recommended, otherwise the Clever Tonie will not stick to the Toniebox. There are two gaps at the bottom so you can stack multiple Clever Tonies together just like the original ones.

You need to pause the print twice to insert the magnets and the RFID tag.

Afterwards you can print a label and glue it onto the Clever Tonie (I print them at the photo shop for a better quality). The labels need to be 35 x 31 mm in size.

Done! Now you can link any audio to the RFID tag in your Clever Tonie by using teddyCloud or teddyBench.

Have fun being creative!
